region: Adapt to local state variety recommendations; source describes a specific modified SRI system

stages.guidance: Use a level, well-drained field; prepare the seedbed and incorporate organic matter according to local soil test.
Select a locally recommended variety and quality seed from a certified source. The cited SRI technology uses 14-day-old seedlings.
The cited method transplants a single 14-day-old seedling at 20 cm × 20 cm spacing. Calendar dates vary by state and season.
The cited method irrigates three days after ponded water disappears through the growing season and stops irrigation 10–15 days before harvest.
The cited package used 5 t FYM/ha plus 80:40:40 kg/ha N:P2O5:K2O. Treat as a study-specific reference and confirm locally with a soil test.
The cited method mechanically weeds at 10, 20 and 30 days after transplanting. Confirm suitability and labor needs locally.
Scout regularly and follow state agriculture/KVK integrated pest management advice; this source does not provide a universal pesticide schedule.
Harvest at locally recommended grain maturity; dry grain safely before storage and follow local moisture and food-safety guidance.
Check current local mandi prices and applicable MSP announcements before deciding when and where to sell.

rotation_suggestion: Consider a locally suitable pulse or oilseed rotation; verify water, season and market suitability.

sources.title: ICAR technology: Modified SRI method for enhancing water productivity of rice

disclaimer: Verify every practice with your local agriculture office or KVK before use. This plan is a cited reference, not a location-specific prescription.
